statement: For paths and cycles the k-Set-DR problem is unsettled for k = 3, 4. The status of Range-DR for paths and cycles is an open problem.
context: For stars, the hardness of the k-Set-DR problem is unsettled for k = 3, 4, 5. For paths and cycles the k-Set-DR problem is unsettled for k = 3, 4. The status of Range-DR for paths and cycles is an open problem.
